title: Classify the Flag
prompt: Implement `const char *flag_intent(const char *flag)` mapping each flag to its intent class: '-Wall' → "warnings", '-Werror' → "escalation", '-g' → "debug-info", '-O2' → "optimization", '-c' → "compile-only", '-fsanitize=address' → "runtime-check", anything else → "other".

tests.name: warning classes
tests.hint: -Wall detects defect classes; -Werror changes failure policy, not detection.

tests.name: build phases
tests.hint: Phase flags select what runs; optimization flags select how hard.

tests.name: runtime tools
tests.hint: Sanitizer flags add runtime machinery; -g adds metadata for humans.
